items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Willie Umphrey is about your age, I believe, isn't he?

ctx.x: Yes. Yes. See, after I faced trouble and I couldn't play drum board anymore, so I tried to drum. Somebody told me you played drums. But I didn't like it because I figured I'd get too old. And then I was trying to even play in the orchestra, you know. And from being trombone sitting in the front of me at the time, well, the people didn't believe that was me, you see. You see, we were to play trombone. So I got so I just didn't like it. And I felt like quitting anyhow, you see. Because we had had such a good…
Yes, I believe you are. Willie Umphrey is about your age, I believe, isn't he?
No, no, I'm older than older.
